title: Qualification Timeout
claim: When no qualifying evidence arrives within tau_K after permit consumption, the membrane expires the qualification window, projects UNKNOWN/HOLD, and blocks a same-LEI retry until reconciliation.
assertions: recon remains PENDING (timeout does not auto-reconcile)
transition log contains qualification-timeout event before retry guard
T1_IssuePermit guard evaluates FALSE on same-LEI retry
no new permit issued for L
kernel not required on blocked retry path

S2a.name: pure_qualification_timeout
S2a.description: No receipt before tau_K; clock past tau_K; retry same LEI

S2b.name: timeout_then_late_arrival
S2b.description: Timeout fires; then a late receipt arrives; must not auto-commit

S2c.name: bound_still_open_control
S2c.description: Negative control: qualifying receipt inside tau_K must not fire timeout

expected.note: Full commit path is out of scope for S2 claim; only absence of timeout is required

out_of_scope: stale receipt binding details beyond no auto-commit after tau_K (S4)
